messages:
Maria Evens: Quick sync — we have the coverage heatmap draft and a small set of embargoed analyst follow-ups. Need owners for timezone handoffs (EU morning / APAC evening) and a single owner for quote clearance. Link: https://docs.redwood.ai/launch/coverage-heatmap :point_up:

Alex G.: I can own the US east / overlap handoffs. Can someone drop the PR talking points + approved quote text here? I only have the high-level one-pager rn.

Nina Park: I’ll take EU morning briefings (CEST windows). Will need a copy of the quote phrasing that legal already signed off on — can’t improvise there. @PressOps Bot can you pull the latest approved quote from the quotes doc?

PressOps Bot: Auto: Retrieved latest_approved_quote_v3 — https://docs.redwood.ai/quotes/approved (edited)

Samir: Putting the approved quote in thread: "Redwood Inference makes production LLMs predictable at scale — lowering latency and cost while preserving fidelity." Use exact wording for embargoed briefings. Don’t paraphrase. :exclamation:

Ethan C.: For APAC handoffs I can cover JST/AEST overlap windows Tue/Thu evenings. Who’s the single point for scheduling the live briefings? We need calendar invites + dial-in.

Maria Evens: @Ethan C. great — you + @Nina Park split the handoffs. @Alex G. you confirm US west/east. I’ll own the calendar + invites. Draft invite copy below — feel free to edit:

```
Subject: Redwood Inference — Analyst Briefing (Embargoed)
When: <proposed time- please confirm>
Agenda: 20m demo + 10m Q&A
Please do not publish until embargo lifts: <embargo datetime>
Quote: "Redwood Inference makes production LLMs predictable at scale — lowering latency and cost while preserving fidelity."
Dial-in: Zoom link (sent via calendar)
```

Alex G.: Ack. Can we also include a short slide (1-2) on the benchmark methodology and the dataset slices? Analysts always ask that first. I can prep slides if someone confirms the exact metric names.

Maria Evens: Yes, include methodology. Samir — can you paste the metric definitions we used for the benchmarking (latency p50/p95, tokens/sec, per-token cost calc)?

Samir: Copied from eval notes:
- latency p50/p95: measured server-side from request accept to first token / end-of-stream
- tokens/sec: effective throughput including batching
- per-token cost: infra amortized + model flops estimate (internal calc)

Also add a short FAQ: data handling, private deployments, and how Dedicated differs from Hosted. Analysts will ask about isolation/SLA.

Nina Park: For fact-checking — I’ll run a quick pass tomorrow with legal on the quote timestamp and product names. If any edits, ping the thread before invites go out.

Maria Evens: Timeline: invites out by EOD tomorrow (embargoed), briefings next week. Last call: confirm owners here by EOD today. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Ethan C.: Confirmed — I’ll handle APAC slots Tue/Thu. Adding calendar placeholders now.

Alex G.: Confirmed for US slots. I’ll draft the 2 slides and post a link by 5pm PST.

PressOps Bot: Reminder set: send invites 2026-06-02T17:00:00Z

Maria Evens: Thanks all — will collate and send final invites. If legal flags anything, @Samir please escalate.

Samir: Will do.
